title: Kagamine Rin — Unfamiliar Versions Of Me〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Um, Rin...
Could you teach me how to play two-person cat's cradle?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You see... I promised Mafuyu I would play with her. But I'm not any good at two-person cat's cradle...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If you can't do it, don't promise to play.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: B-But Mafuyu looked like she was in pain, so I had to say something...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, I know. Would you come with me?
I think that would help Mafuyu—

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You promised her, not me.
I don't have anything to do with this.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'll help you practice at least.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But you're the one who made the promise with Mafuyu. So it's your responsibility.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Okay!
I'll do my best to get better.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The me in this SEKAI can be a little blunt, but she really is kind.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (And she sure is cute when she blushes, too♪)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Everyone, look! Rin did my nails and they're super, uh... They came out perfect!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You forgot what she said aside from the “perfect” part, huh.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm interested in the super hyper ultra max part. How did you come up with that?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Every word you add makes it sound so much cooler. That's just a fact♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You really are good at painting nails, Rin. They always come out so smooth and glossy.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. There's a trick, you know♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let me know when you want your nails redone! I'll do them anytime♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks so much for this, Rin! Now I won't have to worry about the polish cracking while we're performing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Right?
And you get to look so stylish, too! Two birds, one stone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: She looked so focused when she was painting Saki's nails.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It really came through how much she wanted to help Saki practice without any worries.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's support that only she can give them, after all♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
There's also the me who works with DJ Len...
Ah, there she is!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That SEKAI's me looks so confident in this picture.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I remember this! MEIKO was out, so she was working the kitchen instead!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: An can be surprisingly careless sometimes, forgetting her handkerchief like this.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: She really liked my cooking, too. I did think it turned out well, but I'm happy she enjoyed it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Maybe I have a talent for it? Maybe I could open my own branch cafe here in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There's so much I wanted to tell you...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You were supposed to meet Kohane...! And Akito and Toya...! You were supposed to tell me I'd found the best team ever...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And you were supposed to see the moment we did it...! When we surpassed RAD WEEKEND...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You were supposed to do all of that...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey there.
Covering for MEIKO again?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (She's smiling, but she doesn't seem happy.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I can understand why. The person she was so looking forward to meeting is gone, after all...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (She must be forcing herself to smile, so we don't worry about her.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(I can't let her effort go to waste.
Act normal! Smile! Smile!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Could I get a milk tea?
A bit on the sweet side, please.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Here you go!
Your milk tea with extra honey.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's just, I'm so proud of how that milk tea turned out, I want to see you drink it from up close...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (An made up her mind to move on, and is doing her best to smile!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
...Mm. It's delicious.
Very sweet... And very warm.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I see... So that happened between those two.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's very much like the me from that SEKAI. Her kindness really does warm your heart.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thank you all for letting me share in these beautiful memories.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I've been watching over you all...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I'm sure there are many more wonderful memories that I don't know anything about.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It really is so heartening, knowing our SEKAI selves are able to support them from up close.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thank you, from the bottom of my heart, for being there for them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wanted to look around a little longer...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I'm so happy I got to see some new memories I'd never known about.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I know! Maybe this feeling will reach everyone if I put it into a song.
